en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, from someone else, from Aban, from Ziyad Al Shahaam who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I went out from the (Sacred) Masjid and in my clothes were pebbles (taken from the Sacred Masjid)’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So either return it, or throw it back into the Masjid’.
en.sarwar: 4. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from ibn Sama‘ah and from more than one person from Aban from Zayd al-Shahham who has said the following: “
I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the pebbles that I find with me after coming out of the Masjid. He (the Imam) said, ‘Return them or throw in the Masjid.’”
